def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    # Find the oscillating bar
    bar = None
    for body in sandbox.bodies:
        # Check if the body is near the slot barrier (x=15.0m)
        if abs(body.position.x - 15.0) < 0.1:
            bar = body
            break

    # Get the arm (first body)
    arm = sandbox.bodies[0] if sandbox.bodies else None
    if not arm:
        return

    # Determine if the bar is out of the slot
    if bar and (bar.position.y < 1.85 or bar.position.y > 3.35):
        # Bar is out of the slot, swing quickly
        arm.angularVelocity = 20.0  # High angular velocity to pass through the slot quickly
    else:
        # Bar is in the slot, swing slowly
        arm.angularVelocity = 5.0  # Lower angular velocity to avoid collision

    # Check if the head is near the shell
    head = sandbox.bodies[1] if len(sandbox.bodies) > 1 else None
    if head:
        # Check if the head is near the shell (x=16.0, y=2.6)
        if not bar and abs(head.position.x - 16.0) < 0.5 and abs(head.position.y - 2.6) < 0.5:
            # Apply force to break the shell
            head.linearVelocity = (10.0, 0.0)  # Sufficient velocity to break the shell

outcome.failure_reason: Hammer contacted the oscillating bar before shell breakage
